hero.label: Mendix Consulting · Seoul
hero.headline: We turn Mendix licenses into real capability.
hero.subtext: Two Mendix Experts from the Netherlands, based in Seoul. We help enterprises build the internal platform teams that don't need us tomorrow.

problem.headline: Buying Mendix is easy. Making it work is not.
problem.body: Most organisations go live, hit the first wall, and realise their team isn't ready. The platform sits underused. The business case weakens. The vendor gets the blame.
problem.punchline: The license was never the problem.

services.label: What we do
services.headline: Three services, one goal: making your team self-sufficient.
services.item1_desc: Governance, standards, architecture decisions, and team structure. We build the foundation your Mendix practice needs to scale.
services.item2_desc: Hands-on guidance through your first — or most complex — Mendix delivery. We work with your team, not instead of them.
services.item3_desc: An independent review of what you've built, what needs fixing, and what's blocking your next phase.

process.label: How we work
process.headline: From where you are to where you need to be.
process.step1_desc: A structured review of your Mendix maturity, team capability, and platform usage.
process.step2_title: We define where you need to be
process.step2_desc: A clear target — realistic, time-bound, and aligned with your business goals.
process.step3_desc: Hands-on delivery with your team. No black boxes. No dependency on us.
process.step4_title: We leave with a team that doesn't need us
process.step4_desc: That's the goal. A capable internal team that can take it from here.

about.label: About us
about.headline: Dutch expertise. Seoul-based. Built for Asia.
about.body: We started as Mendix developers in the Netherlands and relocated to Seoul in 2022 to support Siemens DISW. Since then, we have built Centers of Excellence for enterprises across East Asia — harmonising the Mendix way of working with how Korean, Taiwanese, and Japanese organisations actually operate.
about.body2: We work remotely and on-site, across time zones. Clients in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Europe. English and Dutch.

contact.label: Get in touch
contact.headline: Ready to talk?
contact.subtext: Tell us where you are with Mendix and what's blocking you. We'll take it from there.

footer.tagline: Mendix expertise for the teams that need it.
